description: This file contains unit tests for the TCPClientSocket class in the Chromium networking code, including tests for connection behavior, socket binding, suspend/resume handling, tagging, and timeout policies.

classes.name: TCPClientSocketTest
classes.description: Test fixture for TCPClientSocket unit tests, including connection, binding, suspend/resume, and timeout behavior.

classes.name: TestSocketPerformanceWatcher
classes.description: Mock implementation of SocketPerformanceWatcher to test notification behavior.

classes.name: NeverConnectingTCPClientSocket
classes.description: Subclass of TCPClientSocket that simulates a socket that never completes connection.

methods.name: CreateConnectedSockets
methods.description: Helper method to create and connect a pair of sockets for testing.

methods.name: BindLoopbackToLoopback
methods.description: Test binding a socket to localhost and connecting to a server on the same interface.

methods.name: BindLoopbackToExternal
methods.description: Test binding to localhost and attempting to connect to an external address, expecting failure.

methods.name: BindLoopbackToIPv6
methods.description: Test binding to IPv4 localhost and connecting to IPv6 localhost, expecting failure.

methods.name: WasEverUsed
methods.description: Test to verify the socket's 'was ever used' state before and after data transmission.

methods.name: DnsAliasesPersistForReuse
methods.description: Test that DNS aliases set on a socket persist across reuse.

methods.name: TestSocketPerformanceWatcher
methods.description: Mock watcher to verify connection change notifications.

methods.name: TestSocketPerformanceWatcher::OnConnectionChanged
methods.description: Increments internal counter when connection change is notified.

methods.name: TestSocketPerformanceWatcher::ShouldNotifyUpdatedRTT
methods.description: Indicates that RTT updates should trigger notifications.

methods.name: TestSocketPerformanceWatcher::OnUpdatedRTTAvailable
methods.description: Callback for RTT updates, no-op in mock.

methods.name: TestSocketPerformanceWatcher::connection_changed_count
methods.description: Returns the number of connection change notifications received.

methods.name: Tag
methods.description: Test verifying socket tagging behavior on Android.

methods.name: TagAfterConnect
methods.description: Test verifying tagging behavior after socket connection.

methods.name: NeverConnectingTCPClientSocket::ConnectInternal
methods.description: Overrides connection attempt to simulate a socket that never completes.

methods.name: SuspendBeforeConnect
methods.description: Test that suspend does not affect sockets that haven't connected yet.

methods.name: SuspendDuringConnect
methods.description: Test that suspend interrupts an ongoing connect attempt.

methods.name: SuspendDuringConnectMultipleAddresses
methods.description: Test suspend behavior with multiple address connection attempts.

methods.name: SuspendWhileIdle
methods.description: Test suspend behavior on an idle, connected socket.

methods.name: SuspendDuringRead
methods.description: Test suspend during a pending read operation.

methods.name: SuspendDuringWrite
methods.description: Test suspend during a write operation.

methods.name: SuspendDuringReadAndWrite
methods.description: Test suspend during simultaneous read and write, with various callback actions.

methods.name: OverrideTcpConnectAttemptTimeout
methods.description: Helper class to override TCP connect attempt timeout parameters for testing.

methods.name: TCPClientSocketMockTimeTest
methods.description: Test fixture for testing TCP connect timeouts with mock time.

methods.name: NoConnectAttemptTimeoutByDefault
methods.description: Test that no timeout is enforced when feature is disabled.

methods.name: ConnectAttemptTimeoutUsesMaxWhenNoRTT
methods.description: Test maximum timeout when no RTT estimate is available.

methods.name: ConnectAttemptTimeoutUsesMinWhenRTTLow
methods.description: Test minimum timeout when RTT estimate is very low.

methods.name: ConnectAttemptTimeoutUsesMinWhenRTTHigh
methods.description: Test maximum timeout when RTT estimate is very high.

methods.name: ConnectAttemptTimeoutUsesRTT
methods.description: Test adaptive timeout based on RTT estimate.

methods.name: ConnectAttemptTimeoutIndependent
methods.description: Test that multiple connection attempts have independent timeouts.
